purpose: Unify MNP reservation-number issuance and MNP One-Stop guidance across carriers/MVNOs with current deep records for nine high-priority services and preserved evidence dates for the legacy long-tail.

semantics.current_exact: Reverified against current official carrier/service information on 2026-09-23.
semantics.carried_forward: Retains the prior official check date; not silently treated as current exact verification.
semantics.one_stop: Reservation number may be unnecessary only when the destination application flow supports MNP One-Stop for that source provider.
semantics.reservation_issue_is_not_cancellation: Issuing a reservation number normally does not terminate the source contract; source cancellation occurs when the MNP transfer completes unless an explicit special rule says otherwise.
semantics.not_assumed_MNP_eligible: A telephone-like number or data/SMS contract is not treated as MNP-eligible without official support.
